native_commands:
/bin/zsh -lc "python - <<'PY'
import io
from rich.console import Console

file = io.StringIO()
console = Console(file=file, force_terminal=True, color_system='standard', width=20)
console.print('soft wrap is on', style='blue on white', soft_wrap=True)
console.print('still has background color from previous line')
output = file.getvalue()
print(repr(output))
assert '\\x1b[34;47msoft wrap is on\\x1b[0m\\n' in output
assert '\\x1b[34;47msoft wrap is on\\n\\x1b[0m' not in output
PY"

/bin/zsh -lc "python - <<'PY'
from rich.console import Console
from rich.segment import Segment

console = Console(force_terminal=True, color_system='standard')
style = console.get_style('blue on white')
output = console._render_buffer([Segment('soft wrap is on\\n', style)])
print(repr(output))
assert output == '\\x1b[34;47msoft wrap is on\\x1b[0m\\n'
PY"

/bin/zsh -lc "python - <<'PY'
from rich.console import Console
for kwargs in ({'force_terminal': True, 'color_system': 'standard'}, {'force_terminal': True, 'color_system': '256'}, {'force_terminal': True, 'color_system': 'truecolor'}):
    c=Console(**kwargs)
    print(kwargs, c._color_system, c.is_terminal)
PY"

/bin/zsh -lc "python - <<'PY'
from rich.console import Console
from rich.segment import Segment

console = Console(force_terminal=True, color_system='standard', no_color=False)
style = console.get_style('blue on white')
output = console._render_buffer([Segment('soft wrap is on\\n', style)])
print(repr(output))
assert output == '\\x1b[34;47msoft wrap is on\\x1b[0m\\n'
output = console._render_buffer([Segment('a\\nb', style)])
assert output == '\\x1b[34;47ma\\x1b[0m\\n\\x1b[34;47mb\\x1b[0m'
PY"
